title: Prove a tensor-stable support-pruning ceiling for the paired BIT word
body:
## Result

**Scoped raw BIT ceiling κ ≤ 0.003890115286594461129996943.** On the exact 36-call paired BIT word, arbitrary tensor power and arbitrary target pruning cannot give strict positive moment at this rate or above when a paid tuple is suppressed only if its recorded Cartesian dependency support misses the retained productive set.

The exact certificate routes every productive rank moment into its dependent paid occurrences. All used arcs satisfy productive rank at least paid rank, so the coupling survives an increase in κ as well as tensor products. Summing over any retained set gives the claimed inequality before charging for actual splits. The pure-Python checker verifies 114,266 nonzero entries against the 18,906 productive occurrences and 104,904 paid occurrences, in 86,730 groups. It rejects a one-tick perturbation.

## Sources and overlap

- Canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57` and the separate CI support commit `0618e75a22cec54d1651394ef83d088551b7f026` used by #8029 and #8033.
- The paired physical word is [#8027](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8027) at `fb9b6a7b0d27da1cf98430893a3016bf811e2aa4`. The standalone package authenticates all 91 files of the installed [#8030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8030) source at `6285dd829114705862e8d91facaedc1f31d3cfcb`.
- [#8032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8032) gives the directed crossing for the whole fixed histogram. This proof extends the obstruction to every retained subset even when empty recorded support removes paid calls. [#8024](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8024) addresses separate arbitrary-field capacity under fixed receipt merging, a different question.

## Replay and scope

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-bit-support-transport
```

The registered check passed locally in 3.66 seconds. It regenerates the incidence from 39,600 inner instructions and 798 outer events, computes outward prices and checks every transport row, column and arc. Certificate SHA-256 `7b163b03d04c0529504156f160a4875e98512d6cccc9a0aab3ec96af3bdeab2a`.

The proof is limited to the stated conservative supports and the frozen word. A stronger algebraic zero test at a paid field with nonempty recorded support, changes of the literal operators, and a different compiler price invariant remain open. The existing all-size native premise supplies the typed linear operator interpretation. This is a raw supplier exclusion.

## Open next questions

Can a paid tuple with nonempty recorded support provably become zero after projection? The first useful test is a small explicit tensor projection with an exact whole-field cancellation check. A gain would also need the changed paid invoice and complete paired application.

Ali Romman supplied the 111-port and single-band source. Predecessor credit and license notices remain in the archive. Clear1nsight contributed the ordered transport and proof. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the research and verification.
